title.en: Jacky Lumarque’s 47 deaths a day: what the linked report actually counted
title.ht: Jacky Lumarque ak 47 mò pa jou a: ki sa rapò li site a te konte?

summary.en: A July 2022 comparison loses a crucial distinction between deaths and injuries. The horror needs no inflated category.
summary.ht: Yon konparezon nan mwa jiyè 2022 pèdi yon diferans enpòtan ant mò ak blese. Gravite vyolans lan pa bezwen konfizyon sa a.

title.en: Lumarque, Quisqueya and the fifty learners between two totals
title.ht: Lumarque, Quisqueya ak diferans 50 elèv ki genyen ant de total yo

summary.en: An encouraging student story leads to a simple arithmetic check—and a larger question about measuring results.
summary.ht: Yon bèl istwa etidyan mennen nou nan yon senp kalkil, epi nan yon pi gwo kesyon sou fason pou mezire rezilta.

title.en: Lumarque’s scholarship promise needs rules that outlive a benefactor
title.ht: Pwomès bous Lumarque yo bezwen règ ki ka dire pi lontan pase moun k ap ede a

summary.en: Personal educational help can change a life. A national policy must explain who qualifies, who pays and how selection stays fair.
summary.ht: Èd pou etid ka chanje lavi yon moun. Yon politik nasyonal dwe esplike kiyès ki kalifye, kiyès ki peye ak kijan chwa yo rete jis.

title.en: Dupuy announced 400 police trainees. Brazil’s records show a first group of 30.
title.ht: Dupuy te anonse fòmasyon pou 400 polisye. Dosye Brezil yo montre yon premye gwoup 30.

summary.en: The documents establish a start, explain a narrower first phase and leave the full outcome unresolved.
summary.ht: Dokiman yo montre yon kòmansman, esplike poukisa premye etap la pi piti epi kite rezilta tout pwogram nan pou verifye.

title.en: Dupuy’s six reform texts: the distance between submitting and changing the rules
title.ht: Sis tèks refòm Dupuy yo: diferans ant soumèt yon tèks ak chanje règ yo

summary.en: Her own August 2024 wording describes possible cabinet adoption. That qualification matters when judging a governing record.
summary.ht: Tèks li te pibliye nan mwa out 2024 la pale de yon posib adopsyon nan Konsèy minis. Nuans sa a konte lè n ap evalye travay li.

title.en: Dupuy’s 33 women: the same announcement, two different tenses
title.ht: Dupuy ak 33 fanm yo: menm anons la, de tan diferan

summary.en: The Creole text promises promotions; the French says they happened. Appointment records would resolve the timing.
summary.ht: Tèks kreyòl la anonse pwomosyon ki pral fèt; franse a di yo deja fèt. Dosye nominasyon yo ta ka klarifye ki lè sa te rive.

title.en: Deronneth’s symposium trail: the cancellation belongs beside the invitation
title.ht: Tras senpozyòm Deronneth yo: avi anilasyon an dwe parèt bò kote envitasyon an

summary.en: A later notice changes what the earlier publicity can prove. Other meetings cannot silently replace the cancelled event.
summary.ht: Yon avi ki vini pita chanje sa anons anvan an ka pwouve. Lòt reyinyon pa ka otomatikman pran plas aktivite ki te anile a.

title.en: Deronneth and the council: rejection, qualified support, congratulations
title.ht: Deronneth ak konsèy la: rejè, sipò avèk rezèv, felisitasyon

summary.en: Three dated messages show a change in public positioning. They do not explain a private motive.
summary.ht: Twa mesaj ki gen dat montre pozisyon piblik la chanje. Yo pa esplike yon motif prive.

title.en: Barrau’s 800 patients: what a clinic photograph cannot count
title.ht: 800 moun Barrau di klinik yo sèvi: sa yon foto pa ka konte

summary.en: His own caption recognises the limits of mobile care. Patient totals and funding need a different kind of evidence.
summary.ht: Tèks li a rekonèt limit klinik mobil yo. Pou verifye kantite moun ak finansman, fòk gen lòt kalite prèv.

title.en: Hans Joseph’s SEL: count the path from investigation to justice
title.ht: SEL Hans Joseph la: mezire chemen ankèt la jouk nan lajistis

summary.en: Security, the rule of law and fighting corruption are clear priorities. Citizens need to see how results would be measured.
summary.ht: Sekirite, Leta de dwa ak batay kont koripsyon se priyorite klè. Sitwayen yo bezwen wè kijan yo ta mezire rezilta yo.
